Bettina, the sources give two dates, so the tracker needs to pick one:

- **2025-11-03** is the official handoff. Moss's Coastal digest from 2 Nov says "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your belated cutover recap (8 Dec) says the same.
- **2025-11-22** is when Kwame took over fully. Your recap says you kept running PHL day to day until 21 Nov for the terminal cutover, and that Kwame "fully took over on November 22."

If the tracker wants the official change-of-ownership date, use 3 Nov 2025. If it tracks when Kwame actually took over day-to-day work, use 22 Nov 2025. I didn't find a formal record of the transfer beyond those notes, so Ruth may know which one the tracker expects.
